net_srv

Network services management — find, dump, create, update, and delete service orders; query usage limits and reports.

Verified against public RPC http://rpc.cellframe.net/ (networks: Backbone, KelVPN).

JSON-RPC request

Method name: net_srv. Response type is 2 (TYPE_RESPONSE_JSON).

Two request formats are supported. The response version echoes the request version and affects JSON field names in order and get_limits responses (see v1 vs v2 field names).

Version 1 — legacy params string

{
  "method": "net_srv",
  "params": ["net_srv;-net;KelVPN;order;find"],
  "id": 1,
  "version": 1
}

params is an array with one string. Every token is separated by ; — not spaces.

Version 2 — subcommand + arguments

{
  "method": "net_srv",
  "subcommand": "order;find",
  "arguments": {"net": "Backbone"},
  "id": 1,
  "version": 2
}

subcommand may also be a JSON array:

{
  "method": "net_srv",
  "subcommand": ["order", "find"],
  "arguments": {"net": "KelVPN", "direction": "sell"},
  "id": 2,
  "version": 2
}

Both forms produce the same internal command: net_srv;order;find;-net;KelVPN;-direction;sell.

Spaces in subcommand do not work. Use "order;find" or ["order","find"], not "order find".

To use version 2 fields, omit params entirely.

Version 2 arguments mapping

arguments keyCLI flagUsed by
net-netAll subcommands except report
H-HHash output format (hex or base58)
direction-directionorder find, order create (sell or buy)
srv_uid-srv_uidorder find, order create, get_limits
srv_class-srv_classorder find
hash-hashorder dump, order update, order delete
price_unit, price_token-price_unit, -price_tokenorder find, order create
price_min, price_max-price_min, -price_maxorder find
price, units, cert-price, -units, -certorder create
node_addr, tx_cond, expires-node_addr, -tx_cond, -expiresorder create
ext, region, continent-ext, -region, -continentorder create, order update
tx_to_json-tx_to_jsonorder dump (bare flag: "")
provider_pkey_hash, client_pkey_hash-provider_pkey_hash, -client_pkey_hashget_limits

Argument values must be strings (or null/empty string for bare flags). JSON numbers and booleans are rejected.

Global options

OptionDescription
-H hex|base58Hash output format (default: hex).
-net <net_name>Network selector (required except for report).

Subcommands

SubcommandDescriptionPublic RPC
order findSearch orders with optional filters.tested
order dump -hashDump one order by hash.tested
reportService usage report (no -net required).tested
get_limitsRemaining service limits for provider/client pair.tested (returns error when no data)
order createCreate a signed order (-cert required since v5.2).requires local certificate and master role — not testable on public node
order update -hashUpdate order extension or location.requires existing order write access — not testable on public node
order delete -hashDelete an order.write operation — not tested on public node

Subcommand syntax (CLI / v1 params)

net_srv;report

net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;find
net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;find;-direction;sell
net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;find;-direction;buy
net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;find;-srv_uid;0x0000000000000014
net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;find;-price_unit;DAY;-price_token;KEL
net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;find;-price_min;10;-price_max;100

net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;dump;-hash;0xORDER_HASH
net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;dump;-hash;0xORDER_HASH;-tx_to_json

net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;delete;-hash;0xORDER_HASH

net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;create;-direction;sell;-srv_uid;0x1;-price;100
  ;-price_unit;DAY;-price_token;KEL;-units;30;-cert;node.dcert
  ;[-node_addr;<addr>][;-tx_cond;<hash>][;-expires;<unix_ts>]
  ;[-ext;<extension>|-region;<region>;-continent;<continent>]

net_srv;-net;<net_name>;order;update;-hash;0xORDER_HASH
  ;[-ext;<extension>|-region;<region>;-continent;<continent>]

net_srv;get_limits;-net;<net_name>;-srv_uid;0x1
  ;-provider_pkey_hash;0xPROVIDER;-client_pkey_hash;0xCLIENT

-direction: sell or buy (maps to SERV_DIR_SELL / SERV_DIR_BUY in responses).

-price_unit for create: B, KB, MB, SEC, DAY, PCS.

Example requests

Version 1

{"method":"net_srv","params":["net_srv;-net;KelVPN;order;find;-direction;sell;-srv_uid;0x0000000000000014"],"id":1,"version":1}

{"method":"net_srv","params":["net_srv;-net;Backbone;order;dump;-hash;0x17C692FA7DD35E66C07F51C1D49595B5F588FFB6C2C728B84A5A58964C9F4CE8"],"id":2,"version":1}

{"method":"net_srv","params":["net_srv;report"],"id":3,"version":1}

{"method":"net_srv","params":["net_srv;get_limits;-net;KelVPN;-srv_uid;0x0000000000000014;-provider_pkey_hash;0xPROVIDER;-client_pkey_hash;0xCLIENT"],"id":4,"version":1}

Version 2 (verified on rpc.cellframe.net)

{"method":"net_srv","subcommand":"order;find","arguments":{"net":"Backbone","direction":"sell","srv_uid":"0x0000000000000014"},"id":1,"version":2}

{"method":"net_srv","subcommand":["order","find"],"arguments":{"net":"KelVPN","direction":"sell"},"id":2,"version":2}

{"method":"net_srv","subcommand":"order;dump","arguments":{"net":"Backbone","hash":"0x17C692FA7DD35E66C07F51C1D49595B5F588FFB6C2C728B84A5A58964C9F4CE8"},"id":3,"version":2}

{"method":"net_srv","subcommand":"report","id":4,"version":2}

{"method":"net_srv","subcommand":"get_limits","arguments":{"net":"KelVPN","srv_uid":"0x0000000000000014","provider_pkey_hash":"0xPROVIDER","client_pkey_hash":"0xCLIENT"},"id":5,"version":2}

Response envelope

Same JSON-response format as other CLI modules:

{
  "type": 2,
  "result": [ { ... } ],
  "id": 1,
  "version": 2
}
  • type — 2 (TYPE_RESPONSE_JSON)
  • result — JSON array of result objects (or error objects)
  • id — echoes the request id
  • version — RPC protocol version (1 or 2)

Errors appear inside result[].errors[]:

{
  "type": 2,
  "result": [
    {
      "errors": [
        { "code": 10, "message": "Can't find order with hash 0x...\n" }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "id": 1,
  "version": 2
}

v1 vs v2 response field names

Version 1Version 2Context
price coinsprice_coinsorder find / order dump order objects
price datoshiprice_datoshiorder objects
price tokenprice_tokenorder objects
price unitprice_unitorder objects
providersig_inf_providerget_limits success response
clientsig_inf_clientget_limits success response

All other order fields (order, direction, srv_uid, node_addr, etc.) use the same names on both versions. Buy orders may include tx_cond_hash.

net_srv order dump

Same fields as a single order object from order find. With -tx_to_json, returns data_hash, data_type, data_size, and base58-encoded data instead.

net_srv order create (not tested on public node)

{
  "result": [
    { "order_hash": "0xNEW_ORDER_HASH..." }
  ]
}

Requires -cert with a private key and node role ≥ master. Without a certificate, returns error code 13 ("The certificate name was not specified...").

net_srv order delete (not tested on public node)

{
  "result": [
    { "order_hash": "0xABCDEF0123456789" }
  ]
}

net_srv order update (not tested on public node)

{
  "result": [
    { "status": "updated" }
  ]
}

net_srv get_limits

// success (field names depend on version)
{
  "result": [
    {
      "sig_inf_provider": "0xPROVIDER_HASH...",
      "sig_inf_client": "0xCLIENT_HASH...",
      "sec": 86400,
      "bytes": 1073741824
    }
  ]
}

Version 1 uses provider / client instead of sig_inf_provider / sig_inf_client. Returns error code 28 when no remain-limits data exists for the given keys (verified on rpc.cellframe.net with dummy hashes).

net_srv report

{
  "result": [
    { "report": "Service report:\n" }
  ]
}

Common error codes

CodeWhen
10Order not found (dump, delete, update).
12order delete missing -hash.
13order create — node role too low, or certificate not specified.
28get_limits — no remain service data for the given provider/client.
102Missing required -net parameter.
